dataset.name: chap-core example data: vietnam_monthly
dataset.description: Monthly dengue cases per province for Vietnam (OpenDengue, Project Tycho source), with rainfall, mean temperature and a static population column, from chap-core example_data.
dataset.notes: Geojson feature ids are the location names. Dropped the pandas index column (first, unnamed) from the source file; otherwise unchanged. Locations are 57 of OpenDengue's 64 Admin1 units (missing: HA NOI CITY, HO CHI MINH CITY, HAI PHONG CITY, DA NANG CITY, CAN THO CITY, THUA THIEN - HUE, HA TAY). Origin of the climate and population columns and of the geojson is not documented in chap-core (added in commit 9da8dad3, 'feature: vietnam dataset').
dataset.schema_status: scaffold: values marked TODO are not verified

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: Total precipitation over the month within the province.

source.provider: ERA5-Land via Google Earth Engine (chap-core pipeline)
source.notes: Not documented. Values have 3 decimals and monthly magnitudes (0.2 to 1063, mean 169) that match chap-core's GEE ERA5-Land converter (meter_to_mm: round(m*1000, 3), monthly sum of daily totals), but no script links this file to it. Series identical to the chap-core ERA5-Land output in full_data vietnam.csv; correlation >= 0.99 with dengue/vietnam_1998-2010.

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Mean 2m air temperature over the month within the province.

source.provider: ERA5-Land via Google Earth Engine (chap-core pipeline)
source.notes: Not documented. Values have 2 decimals and range 8.7 to 30.6, matching chap-core's GEE ERA5-Land converter (kelvin_to_celsium: round(K-273.15, 2)), but no script links this file to it. Series identical to the chap-core ERA5-Land output in full_data vietnam.csv; correlation >= 0.99 with dengue/vietnam_1998-2010.

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Reported dengue cases per province and month (OpenDengue dengue_total).

source.notes: All 10924 non-empty values equal OpenDengue V1.2.2 dengue_total for adm_0_name 'VIET NAM', S_res Admin1, T_res Month; all rows have UUID TYCHO-ALL-19242017-SV_DF01-00. chap-core scripts/explorations/temporal_downsampling.py wrote vietnam_monthly.csv from OpenDengueDataSet().subset('Viet nam', 'Admin1', 'Month').

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population per province, one static value for all months.

source.notes: Not documented. One constant value per location (sum 71.3 million over 57 provinces), so a count of persons; source and reference year unknown. WRONG for QUANG NINH (1437) and KHANH HOA (2922), real ~1.2 million each; PHU THO is 42% of the value in dengue/vietnam_1998-2010. Cause unknown.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Province name as in OpenDengue adm_1_name (upper case).
